briefdescription.para: Defines the ArthropodsLandscape class for arthropod-specific ecosystem simulations.

detaileddescription.para: This file declares the ArthropodsLandscape class, a specialization of the Landscape base class, implementing metabolic, behavioural, and ecological processes specific to arthropod species. It provides functionality for calculating voracity, metabolic losses, wet food availability, and movement adjustments for arthropods.
